# Vaders Cross Country

Vaders XC is a middle school cross country team made up of athletes from St. Norbert School (SNS) and Sacred Heart School in Northbrook, IL. The program is volunteer-coached and runs in the fall season.

## Key facts
- Practice days: Wednesdays and Fridays, 5:00–6:00 PM
- Meet location: St. Norbert School gym lobby, then Village Green Park across the street
- Coaches: Jake Schmitz (SNS dad) and Dana Macke (SNS mom)
- Season: Late August through mid–late October
- Schedule app: TeamSnap (invites sent by Drew Swanson, Sacred Heart AD)

## Pages
- / — Season overview, announcements, practice schedule, meet schedule, coach info
- /resources.html — Dynamic warm-up drills, skips, core exercises for athletes
- /xc-practice-1.html — Practice 1: Welcome session and baseline mile time trial (August 19)
- /xc-practice-2.html — Practice 2: Interval repeats around the baseball field at Village Green (August 21)
- /xc-practice-3.html — Practice 3: Village Green loops with water breaks at the baseball field (August 26)
- /xc-practice-4.html — Practice 4: Village Green loops with cone drill breaks at the baseball field (August 29)
